# Tensor_Accelerated_Eager_Grids

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A tensor-accelerated grid representation that performs eager multi-resolution updates for evolving large-scale substrates. It enables TCC/iNEST systems to adapt spatial resolution and data layout rapidly as substrate topology changes.
